范梦雪走到床边坐下，轻声道：

“杨姐，我知道你心里很乱，也知道你有心事。师兄他很担心你，他昨晚守了你一夜，连饭都没吃。”

杨童没有回应，周身的冷漠气息，依旧没有散去。

范梦雪没有放弃，继续说道：

“杨姐，师兄跟我说了，他两次陷入了幻境，看到了你们前世的事情。他说你也通过三生石看到了同样的画面，对不对？”

这句话像是戳中了杨童的心事，她的身体微微一僵，缓缓睁开眼，眼底闪过一丝复杂的情绪。

范梦雪连忙说道：

“杨姐，你是不是也有什么难处？你告诉我们，我们一起帮你想办法，别一个人扛着，也别再对师兄那么冷漠了，他真的很在乎你。”

杨童沉默了许久。

“我不是故意要对他冷漠的，我只是……不知道该如何面对他。”

“为什么？”

范梦雪轻声问道。

“因为，在我昏迷的时候，我也陷入了幻境。我看到的画面和他的幻境一模一样，我们前世相爱，最后我却背叛了他。那种感觉太真实了，真实得让我害怕。三生石看到的只是零散的画面，可幻境里的一切，都那么清晰，我甚至能感受到当时的情绪，可我却不知道，我为什么要背叛他。”

范梦雪说道：

“但是幻境终究只是幻境啊！”

杨童苦涩一笑。

“我怕前世的背叛是真的，我怕我今生也会不小心伤害到他。我只能把他推开，只能对他冷漠，这样他就不会再因为我受到伤害了。”

范梦雪心中满是心疼，轻轻拍了拍她的后背，轻声安慰道：

“杨姐，你别太自责，也别太害怕。他只是很担心你，很想知道你心里的想法。”

“可是前世我真的背叛了他。三生石都有画面，幻境又那么真实，这肯定是真的。”

“前世是前世，今生是今生啊，就算前世真的有背叛，那也是前世的你，和今生的你，有什么关系？”

杨童沉默不语。

“我知道你心里很难过，不如你们好好谈一谈，把话说开，一切都会好起来的。”

Fan Mengxue walked to the bed and sat down, saying softly:

"Sister Yang, I know you are very confused and have something on your mind. Senior brother, he is very worried about you. He stayed with you all night last night and didn't even eat."

Yang Tong did not respond, and the aloof indifference around him still did not dissipate.

Fan Mengxue did not give up and continued:

"Sister Yang, my senior brother told me that he fell into illusion twice and saw what happened in your previous life. He said that you also saw the same scene through the Sansheng Stone, right?"

This sentence seemed to hit Yang Tong's mind. Her body stiffened slightly and she slowly opened her eyes, with a trace of complicated emotions flashing through her eyes.

Fan Mengxue said quickly:

"Sister Yang, do you have any difficulties? Tell us and we will help you find a solution together. Don't carry it alone, and stop being so indifferent to your senior brother. He really cares about you."

Yang Tong was silent for a long time.

"I didn't mean to be indifferent to him, I just... didn't know how to face him."

"Why?"

Fan Mengxue asked softly.

"Because, when I was in a coma, I also fell into a fantasy. The pictures I saw were exactly the same as his fantasy. We fell in love in the previous life, but I betrayed him in the end. That feeling was too real, so real that it scared me. Sanshengshi saw only scattered pictures, but everything in the fantasy was so clear. I could even feel the emotions at that time, but I didn't know why I betrayed him."

Fan Mengxue said:

"But an illusion is just an illusion after all!"

Yang Tong smiled bitterly.

"I'm afraid that the betrayal in my previous life is real, and I'm afraid that I will accidentally hurt him in this life. I can only push him away, and I can only be indifferent to him, so that he will not be hurt because of me again."

Fan Mengxue felt distressed in her heart, patted her back gently, and comforted her softly:

"Sister Yang, don't blame yourself too much, and don't be too afraid. He is just worried about you and wants to know what you are thinking."

"But I really betrayed him in my previous life. The three life stones have pictures, and the illusion is so real. This must be true."

"The past life is the past life, and this life is this life. Even if there is true betrayal in the past life, it is still you in the previous life. What does it have to do with you in this life?"

Yang Tong remained silent.

"I know you're feeling sad. Why don't you guys have a good talk and talk things out? Everything will be fine."
